provenance.kind: software reference, Python; no board, no FPGA, no real platform send
provenance.image_note: a publicly available illustrative cardiac MRI, supplied by the owner from a web image search (2026-10-19). De-identified, not a hospital record, no patient data. NOT committed to the repo -- see tools/stego_research/covers/README.md; passed by path and pinned by SHA-256 so the run is comparable.
provenance.channels_note: MODELLED chat-app channels, NOT real sends: long-edge downscale + JPEG re-encode + EXIF strip. Only tools/phase_a_platforms/ can measure a real platform, and it needs the owner's phone.

cover_render.reason: the payload needs 4 x BLOCKS_PER_REGION eligible LL blocks outside the ROI and the pilot grid removes about half the universe; the native thumbnail is far too small (see the capacity table)

parameters.thresholds: NOT YET AGREED with the professor; this file reports rates and does not declare pass/fail

variants.description: the scan as delivered; large areas of the margin are clipped at 0
variants.cannot_mark: cannot place 256 blocks in every region: available [36, 40, 23, 5]; ignoring the ROI taint [137, 130, 174, 99], ignoring the clipping taint [414, 418, 385, 438].  If the clipping counts are the low ones, the image's non-diagnostic area sits on a uint8 clipping level (a clipped black margin is the common case) and the fix is to normalise the amplitude at intake, not to change the transform.  Otherwise grow the cover, shrink the ROI clearance, or widen the pilot interval.  CLIP_RULE records the measurement.

clipping.note: cover-level count over the whole universe; no placements exist because marking was refused

variants.description: identical image with the black level lifted by 16 (no clipping at 0)

clipping.note: a flat block at the clipping level (pixel min 0 or max 255, range <= 1) cannot hold the mark through a re-encode: the codec makes it a constant
